title: Crypto Manager
description: This is a project about managing all asset data how much you have gained and lost in crypto investment. You can track all your asset at one plus and especially, ROI many people don't know how much they invested in the crypto, and at last, they get fooled. We will give rewards to people who will hold assets in crypto manager. To engage more people in the Crypto Manager, I have decided to make a referral program where people will get some amount of token (Crypto Manager).
how_its_made: This project will use Covalent API and Trading View API for prices. I will also use swaps like 1 Inch and Uniswap for buying and using Crypto Manager,
